notes.text: No guided nature walks were found this week in Neris Regional Park, Trakai or Vilnius (the park's listings stop in spring). The Kernavė Family Day on Sunday 29 Nov includes a hike at 15:00. For a self-guided outing, try the Sapieginė trail in Verkiai Regional Park or an evening light trail (Lumina in the VU Botanical Garden, Rumšiškės).
Elektrėnai culture centre's calendar blocked access again, so near-home listings for this week could not be checked; see its site for events in Elektrėnai and Vievis.
Rytas Vilnius home fixtures this week could not be confirmed (home games are planned for Arena Vilnius); check the club and LKL sites. The A Lyga football season is over.

Advent begins on Sunday 29 November. Tree lightings: Trakai 27 Nov, Kruonis 28 Nov, Vilnius 28 Nov, Kaišiadorys 4 Dec, Lentvaris 4 Dec, Rūdiškės 5 Dec. Elektrėnai and Vievis dates were not found; Kazokiškės lights up on 18 Dec.
